description: Resource bounds and truncation markers for redaction and serialization.

dos: Bound traversal depth, object keys, array items, string size, and text output size.
Use 10,000 characters as the default maxString limit for serialized string values and redactText output.
Use [TRUNCATED] for text truncation and [REDACTED] for sensitive-value replacement.
Keep output within a configured maxString limit.
donts: Do not promise a complete truncation marker when the configured limit is shorter than the marker; in that case bounded output takes precedence.
